feed.title: Amazon (NASDAQ: AMZN) Sets $60 Billion Ceiling With Qualcomm (NASDAQ: QCOM) As Apple (NASDAQ: AAPL) Cuts Modem Ties
feed.summary: Amazon has set a potential $60 billion commercial relationship with Qualcomm for AI infrastructure, including server chips, systems, and optical connectivity. This agreement is significant for Qualcomm as Apple shifts its modem development in-house, impacting Qualcomm's revenue. The deal includes warrants for Amazon, vesting based on purchasing milestones, and aims to help Qualcomm diversify its revenue streams into data centers.

feed.title: Wells Fargo sees AI slowdown as unlikely despite safety calls
feed.summary: Wells Fargo believes a coordinated slowdown in AI development is improbable despite calls for safety pauses from industry leaders like Anthropic and OpenAI. The bank suggests that any slowdown is more likely to stem from supply-side bottlenecks such as power availability and permit delays, rather than a consensual halt in demand within the highly competitive AI market. Wells Fargo also noted that an elongated AI buildout due to these constraints could ultimately support long-term multiples for certain midstream companies.

feed.title: How Saucy by KFC launched in record time and almost with a different name
feed.summary: Yum! Brands' new test concept, Saucy by KFC, focuses on a diverse range of 11 signature sauces, aiming to appeal to younger consumers with a quick-service model. The concept was developed rapidly through an independent "corporate rebels" team and extensive consumer research, which ultimately led to its sauce-centric name over the initial idea of "Tendies." Saucy by KFC emphasizes a tech-forward approach for operational efficiency, a distinctive "PINK" design, and aims to provide a unique customer and employee experience, with plans for expansion based on market performance.

feed.title: Chipotle Mexican Grill (CMG) Could Be 30% Overvalued On Seoul Expansion Push
feed.summary: Chipotle Mexican Grill (CMG) is expanding into Asia with its first restaurant in Seoul, which management plans to use as a template for further regional entries. While the company has seen recent share price momentum, analysts suggest the stock could be 30% overvalued based on a fair value estimate of $27.88 compared to its closing price of $36.20, raising questions about whether its growth potential is already priced in. feed.title: J&J’s Contineum-partnered depression drug flunks another phase 2 test
